notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around standard Flush Queue grant delivery. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It verifies suppression and release of a queued timestamped interaction and flushQueueGrant, delivery ordering, exact payload/tag/producer/time/order/retraction metadata, and federation/time cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with timestamped SendInteraction/Flush Queue services and FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction, flushQueueGrant, and timeAdvanceGrant delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and Flush Queue declarations
